reference_sql:
WITH sessions_2013 AS (
  -- one row per session started in 2013: its month, its traffic source and the orders placed in it
  SELECT s.website_session_id,
         CAST(date_trunc('month', s.created_at) AS DATE) AS session_month,
         s.utm_source,
         COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders
  FROM website_sessions AS s
  LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.website_session_id = s.website_session_id
  WHERE s.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2013-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND s.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY s.website_session_id, s.created_at, s.utm_source
)
SELECT session_month,
       utm_source,
       COUNT(*) AS sessions,
       SUM(orders) AS orders,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE orders > 0) / COUNT(*), 2) AS conversion_pct
FROM sessions_2013
GROUP BY session_month, utm_source
ORDER BY session_month, utm_source

WITH session_orders AS (
  -- one row per session that placed an order: how many orders it placed
  SELECT website_session_id, COUNT(*) AS orders
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY website_session_id
)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', s.created_at) AS DATE) AS session_month,
       s.utm_source,
       COUNT(*) AS sessions,
       COALESCE(SUM(so.orders), 0) AS orders,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(so.website_session_id) / COUNT(*), 2) AS conversion_pct
FROM website_sessions AS s
LEFT JOIN session_orders AS so ON so.website_session_id = s.website_session_id
WHERE s.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2013-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND s.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', s.created_at) AS DATE), s.utm_source
ORDER BY session_month, utm_source

       COUNT(DISTINCT s.website_session_id) AS sessions,
       COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT o.website_session_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT s.website_session_id), 2) AS conversion_pct
FROM website_sessions AS s
LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.website_session_id = s.website_session_id
WHERE s.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2013-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND s.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', s.created_at) AS DATE), s.utm_source

solver.query:
WITH o AS (SELECT website_session_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY website_session_id)
SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', s.created_at) AS DATE) AS session_month,
       s.utm_source,
       COUNT(*) AS sessions,
       COALESCE(SUM(o.n), 0) AS orders,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(o.website_session_id) / COUNT(*), 2) AS conversion_pct
FROM website_sessions s LEFT JOIN o ON o.website_session_id = s.website_session_id
WHERE s.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2013-01-01' AND s.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2014-01-01'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY session_month, utm_source
